verdict.rationale: The current reflect.app homepage claims an open-source app built on local Markdown files, with sync of your choice via iCloud Drive or Git, which would let a user avoid the vendor's cloud. However, these are thin marketing lines that sit oddly against other first-party docs describing server-stored, end-to-end-encrypted notes and a hosted API at reflect.app/api, so the depth and current scope of a cloud-free mode are unclear. Missing for 10: detailed docs on local-only operation, documentation of Git or self-hosted sync setup, any statement that no vendor account or server is required, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
